problem_statement: V58 has no executable BTC trend-following long route. Its only long route requires an hourly downside sweep, while both Hulk routes are short-only. This preflight tests only whether a materially distinct leveraged-demand continuation footprint occurs often enough for a later outcome experiment.
mechanism: A positive BTC price shock accompanied by expanding open interest is more consistent with new leveraged demand than with short-covering alone. Positive terminal taker flow and bid-side top-ten depth are required as same-venue confirmation. This stage measures causal setup cadence only and makes no return or profitability claim.

stage_boundary.reason: Cadence and causal source feasibility must qualify before an outcome protocol or exit can be selected.

source_contract.source_identity_registration: required before the first preflight run
source_contract.timestamp_semantics: received_ts_ns is the only feature-availability clock
source_contract.gap_policy: Any missing common OI, trade, or L2 minute starts a new segment and resets all rolling history. No interpolation, filling, or bridging is permitted.
source_contract.data_availability_limitation: activeAssetCtx has no exchange event timestamp; receipt time is causal but includes network and recorder latency

frozen_partitions.name: pseudo_holdout
frozen_partitions.role: descriptive cadence acceptance only after the recorder gap resets history

partition_disclosure: All calendar windows have been opened by other project research. No pristine return holdout is claimed. This exact OI-expansion full-candidate outcome has not been computed before this preregistration, and this stage is forbidden from computing it.

frozen_signal_contract.price_threshold: positive five-minute close-to-close return must equal or exceed the fixed minimum and the prior-only rolling quantile of absolute five-minute returns
frozen_signal_contract.oi_threshold: five-minute terminal open-interest percentage change must equal or exceed the fixed minimum and the prior-only rolling quantile of five-minute OI changes
frozen_signal_contract.terminal_trade_imbalance_definition: last completed one-minute buy minus sell aggressor notional divided by total aggressor notional
frozen_signal_contract.terminal_top10_book_imbalance_definition: last causally received top-ten bid depth minus ask depth divided by their sum
frozen_signal_contract.onset_policy: retain the first qualifying row, then suppress later qualifying rows at or before the retained decision plus 60 minutes

cadence_selection_contract.rule: select the strictest candidate quantile with at least the minimum development candidate onsets
cadence_selection_contract.tie_break: higher quantile is always stricter and wins

outcome_stage_authorization: requires a new preregistration after cadence qualification

future_outcome_requirements_if_cadence_q.entry: first complete non-crossed L2 quote at or after the next minute boundary, maximum 15-second receipt delay, buy at ask
future_outcome_requirements_if_cadence_q.exit: first complete non-crossed L2 quote at or after 60 minutes, maximum 15-second receipt delay, sell at bid

prior_search_accounting.restriction: This preflight may not reopen, retune, or reinterpret any rejected family.

known_failure_modes: OI expansion can represent late crowded leverage rather than durable demand.
Displayed book imbalance can be fleeting and cannot reveal hidden liquidity.
Terminal one-minute flow can reverse immediately after the decision boundary.
Recorder gaps can make apparent sample counts non-comparable across segments.
Sufficient cadence does not imply association, tradability, or profitability.
falsifiers: Any required source identity mismatch, duplicate minute, null feature, crossed source book, or bridged gap invalidates the preflight.
Any forward outcome field in the preflight invalidates the stage boundary.
No quantile meeting the development count or either OOS minimum forces data-insufficient disposition without threshold relaxation.
